acquisition_method.evidence: In this dataset, we compared 4 replicates of DM to 4 replicates of SF derived cardiac organoids using global DIA-MS/MS.

For each sample, a uniform volume (3 µl) was resolved across a 55 min gradient in data-independent acquisition mode using a Thermo PepMap100 analytical column equipped on a Thermo Vanquish Neo UHPLC interfaced with a Thermo Exactive HF-X mass spectrometer.
